study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier (e.g., AuthorX_YYYY) is given in the text.

subject_id.notes: No per-participant identifiers are provided in the main text; individual data likely reside only in unprovided supplementary tables.

sample_id.notes: No per-sample identifiers are provided in the main text.

pmid.notes: The paper_id (37069399) was supplied by the user as metadata, not extracted from body text as a PMID.

subcohort.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
subcohort.notes: AN cases were divided into AN-RS (n=56) and AN-BP (n=21) subtypes; treated here as potential subcohorts of the AN group.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder with a high mortality.
target_condition.notes: HC group represents healthy controls, not a target condition.

control.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females

country.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples
body_site.notes: Serum samples were also collected for metabolomics but body_site enum only allows one primary microbiome-relevant site; feces chosen as the metagenomics sample source.

days_from_first_collection.notes: Study appears cross-sectional; no longitudinal sampling of humans is described.

location.evidence_quote: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital) and Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital)

probing_pocket_depth.notes: Not applicable; study is not oral/periodontal.

westernized.notes: Population is Danish (a westernized country) but the term 'westernized' is never explicitly used in the text.

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Same exclusion criterion applied to both AN cases and HC controls (control exclusion: 'antibiotics within the last 3 months').

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed following IHMS SOP P7 V2
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Faecal sample collection and DNA extraction
dna_extraction_kit.notes: No specific commercial kit name matching the enum list is given for the main human cohort; a NucleoSpin soil mini kit (MACHEREY-NAGEL) was used specifically for the mouse/human-donor 16S rRNA sequencing experiment, not the primary shotgun metagenomics cohort.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer (Thermo Fisher)
sequencing_platform.notes: Illumina MiSeq was used separately for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of the mouse FMT experiment, not the primary human shotgun metagenomics cohort.

age.evidence_quote: females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2
age.notes: Specific ages are only reported for the three AN and three HC faecal donors used for FMT experiments (AN: 20, 22, 20 yr; HC: 20, 22, 21 yr), not for the overall human cohort (mean/SD age of the 77 AN and 70 HC participants is stated to be in Supplementary Table 2, which is not provided in the given text).

age_group.evidence_quote: Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital)
age_group.notes: Recruitment included an adolescent psychiatric unit, suggesting a mix of adolescent and adult participants, but no explicit age-group breakdown or overall age range is stated in the provided text.

age_unit.notes: Only reported for the FMT donor subset.

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

ancestry_details.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

age_min.notes: Only individual FMT-donor ages reported (see samples); no cohort-wide age range given in provided text.

age_max.notes: Only individual FMT-donor ages reported (see samples); no cohort-wide age range given in provided text.

age_years.notes: Cohort-wide mean age not present in provided text (deferred to Supplementary Table 2, not included). Individual donor ages captured in 'samples'.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Derived from exclusion criteria; participants using antibiotics within 3 months were excluded, implying no current antibiotic use at enrollment for both AN and HC groups (also stated for controls: 'antibiotics within the last 3 months').

bmi.notes: Cohort-wide BMI values reside in Supplementary Table 1/2, not included in provided text. Individual donor BMIs captured in 'samples'.

dietary_restriction.notes: Energy-restricted diet (30%) was applied to mouse recipients, not a documented human participant dietary restriction category.

disease.evidence_quote: a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females
disease.notes: HC group represents 'Healthy' controls; AN group has Anorexia Nervosa.

disease_details.evidence_quote: the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type

feces_phenotype.notes: Fecal samples were collected and analyzed but no specific fecal phenotype/clinical measure term matching schema was reported.

fmt_id.notes: Only group-level labels AN-T and HC-T given; no individual donor/recipient IDs provided.

fmt_role.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN...and three HC...who were representatives of cases and controls were used to colonize 6-week-old female GF littermates.
fmt_role.notes: Applies to the 6 human donors listed in samples; mouse recipients also exist but lack individual age/BMI data so are not represented as samples.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills
obgyn_birth_control.notes: Birth control pills were an allowed exception to the 'no regular medication' exclusion criterion for HC; does not confirm actual current use, so not scored as definitive Yes/No.

smoker.evidence_quote: including age, BMI, smoking and multiple drug intake were corrected
smoker.notes: Smoking was used as a deconfounding covariate but individual/group smoking status/rates are not given in the provided text (likely in Supplementary Table 2).

treatment.evidence_quote: Medication included selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines.
treatment.notes: These medications were used by some AN cases and were deconfounded for in analyses.

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: women with AN were much leaner, had lower fasting serum concentrations of glucose and insulin, higher insulin sensitivity as estimated by homoeostatic model assessment for insulin resistance (HOMA-IR) and lower serum C-reactive protein
biomarker_name.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
biomarker_name.notes: Biomarkers (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP) are mentioned qualitatively (higher/lower) but exact numeric values are only in Supplementary Table 1/2, which is not provided in the extracted text. Cannot reliably populate paired name/unit/value lists without fabricating numbers.

biomarker_unit.notes: No specific units reported for biomarker values in the available text; detailed values are in Supplementary Table 1/2 (not included).

biomarker_value.notes: Only qualitative direction (higher/lower) given for glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP; no numeric values in available text.

disease_response_os.notes: This is a cross-sectional cohort/microbiome study; overall survival is not measured or reported.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status is an oncology-specific measure not applicable to this eating disorder/microbiome study; not reported.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No field labeled 'feces_phenotype' or clearly corresponding categorical stool phenotype (e.g., Bristol stool scale) was reported; extensive fecal microbiome data exist but do not match this schema field definition.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: No tumor-related measurements in this study (anorexia nervosa/gut microbiota research, not oncology).

value: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.
AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).
Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.
Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.
Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.
Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).
Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.
Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
uncurated_metadata.notes: Compiled free-text metadata describing study design not captured by other schema fields.

host_species.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples, respectively, from a cohort of 77 females with AN and 70 healthy females.
host_species.notes: The study also includes a mouse (Mus musculus) experimental arm using germ-free female Swiss Webster mice for faecal microbiota transplantation (FMT), but the primary participant cohort analyzed via metagenomics/metabolomics is human (Homo sapiens).

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

samples.uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

extraction_warnings: No per-participant or per-sample level table (subject_id, sample_id) is present in the provided text; these fields are unresolved at subgroup level only.

Detailed demographic statistics (age, BMI, etc.) are referenced as being in Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, which were not included in the provided text, limiting extraction of quantitative age/BMI values.

DNA extraction kit and some other methodological fields could not be matched to a specific enum value from the allowed list for the main human cohort; only a mouse/16S-specific kit (NucleoSpin soil) was named.
The paper describes multiple sequencing methods (Ion Proton for shotgun metagenomics, Illumina MiSeq for 16S in mouse experiments); only the primary human cohort platform (IonProton) was extracted.

AN-RS and AN-BP subtype-level data exist but were not treated as full separate subgroups in this extraction to keep to the primary AN vs HC case-control comparison; subcohort field partially reflects this.
Batch 1 returned granularity='sample_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

Cohort-wide age and BMI values for the 77 AN and 70 HC participants are reported only in Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, which were not included in the provided text; these fields are marked not_reported at the study level.
Sample-level data (age, BMI) were only explicitly given for the 6 human FMT donors (3 AN, 3 HC) used in the mouse transplantation experiment; these are captured in the 'samples' array.
Mouse FMT recipients (AN-T, HC-T, n=10 each) lack individual age/BMI values and were not included as separate sample rows.
Smoking status, exact medication use per participant, and birth control pill usage rates are not explicitly quantified in the provided text; only used as covariates or exclusion criteria.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

This study is an eating-disorder/gut microbiome paper, not an oncology clinical trial; several schema fields (ECOG performance status, tumor size, overall survival) are not applicable and were marked not_reported.

Detailed numeric biomarker values (glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP, etc.) are referenced as being in Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Table 2, but the actual numeric data tables were not included in the provided text, so biomarker_name/unit/value could not be populated with real numbers.
The paper includes both a human cohort and a mouse FMT experiment; host_species field only accepts a single string, so 'Homo sapiens' was chosen as primary with a note about the mouse arm.

No field in the schema clearly maps to 'feces_phenotype_value'; despite extensive fecal microbiome composition data, no explicit categorical fecal phenotype (e.g., consistency/Bristol scale) was reported.
